caption_draft: **Native response-time tail and the resulting coverage.** (a) fraction exceeding a given CLRT, per class; (b) transactions not coverable, against added latency $D$.
statistical_method: Survival function and coverage computed over the 31,680 native transactions of the 22 sessions. D_A = 20 ms and D_R = 4 ms, so D = 24 ms; the master-visible cross-layer response time under the mechanism equals D_R.
